title.zh: Business App 历史消息同步

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，需要将消息、回执等webhook配置好[UpdatePhoneWebhook](~~600763~~)、[UpdateAccountWebhook](~~600765~~)，不然历史消息同步时找不到配置的webhook地址，会导致同步失败。

- 此接口只会生效一次，一次调用后，后续再次调用不会再产生历史消息推送。
descriptions.en:
- Before calling this operation, configure the webhooks for messages and receipts by using [UpdatePhoneWebhook](~~600763~~) and [UpdateAccountWebhook](~~600765~~). Otherwise, the webhook address cannot be found during historical message synchronization, which causes the synchronization to fail.

- This operation takes effect only once. After the first call, subsequent calls do not trigger historical message pushes.
